turns.text: You are the new agent. So what should you do to become a professional in your area?

First, check the building Google reviews. Over there you have all the information about the downside of the building, the complaints, the possibility for you to talk about the price reduction with your sellers.
Study the floor plans, but when you look at the floor plans, understand for whom this unit going to be suitable and why. Kitchen, balcony, all of that is important.
And visit the area, walk inside the building and talk to people who are living there. Ask them what do they like and they do not like about this building.
I have five more tips how to study the area, but for that, you have to come and learn from me in Chestertons.
